subject: CloudConnector marketplace inquiry — intro + demo scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cloudconnector.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Inquiry from Marketplace listing — looking to book an intro/demo

Hi Lauren,

We came across Redwood on the Cloud Marketplace and I completed a quick self-serve signup to poke around. CloudConnector is evaluating inference platforms for a new summarization feature and we liked the performance notes on your listing.

High level:
- 20–50M tokens/month to start, likely bursty in the US east region
- Interested in dedicated capacity and VPC/private options for data isolation
- Need a short intro and a demo of latency/cost patterns and rollouts

Would you or someone on your team be available for a 30–45 minute intro/demo next week? We prefer mornings PT but can be flexible.

Attached a short doc with our infra/requirements for context.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Engineering
CloudConnector Inc
Attachment: brief-infra-needs.pdf (pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cloudconnector.io>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Inquiry from Marketplace listing — looking to book an intro/demo

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for trying Redwood via the Marketplace. Glad the listing caught your eye.

Happy to run a short intro + demo and walk through options (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Quick questions so we can make the session most useful:
- Is there a preferred model family (open models or are you evaluating hosted model access)?
- Any strict data residency / KMS requirements we should flag ahead of time?

Two possible slots:
- Tue 6 Apr, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu 8 Apr, 09:00–09:45 PT

If those don't work, pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/lauren-redwood/30min

I'm cc'ing Dylan here — he handles initial demos for marketplace leads and will join to run the live workload walkthrough.

Short one-pager attached that covers what we typically demo.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
SDR Lead, Americas
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: CloudConnector marketplace inquiry — quick context and ask

Dylan — forwarding CloudConnector. Quick context below and a couple asks:
- They did a self-serve signup from the marketplace and attached infra notes.
- Likely wants predictable throughput and data isolation (private/VPC).
- Prefer mornings PT; proposed 6 Apr 10am PT or 8 Apr 9am PT.

Can you own the demo? Focus: latency/cost tradeoffs, Dedicated vs Private, rollout options. I can intro at the start and then hand off. If you can take it, propose final time and send invite; include agenda (5m intro, 20m demo with live workload, 15m Q&A + procurement next steps).

Thanks — L.
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cloudconnector.io>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 01:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CloudConnector marketplace inquiry — intro + demo scheduling

Hi Lauren / Alex — happy to take this.

I can do Thu 8 Apr, 09:00 PT (09:00–09:45 PT). If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a Zoom link.

Proposed agenda (brief):
- 5m introductions
- 20m demo: live gen on a sample prompt + latency/cost breakdown
- 10m deployment & security options (Dedicated, VPC, KMS)
- 10m procurement/next steps (SLA, onboarding timeline)

I'll attach a suggested agenda and a HubSpot link for the contact record when I send the invite.

—Dylan
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@cloudconnector.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com

I've attached a very small availability grid — should make it easy to see options.

If Friday is better for you, fine to confirm that time.

Cheers,
